bio: Junior Web Developer and second-year web development student, with internship experience building frontends in React and TypeScript. I have a backend foundation in Java, Spring Boot and Node.js, and I run my own Linux server with Docker, where I deploy and maintain applications in production. I like understanding how everything works, from the interface to the infrastructure, and I learn fast on real projects.
